(* File: Bernoulli.thy Author: Lukas Bulwahn <lukas.bulwahn-at-gmail.com> Author: Manuel Eberl <manuel@pruvisto.org> *) section \<open>Bernoulli numbers\<close>
theory Bernoulli imports Complex_Main begin
subsection \<open>Preliminaries\<close>
lemma power_numeral_reduce: "a ^ numeral n = a * a ^ pred_numeral n"
sorry
lemma fact_diff_Suc: "n < Suc m \<Longrightarrow> fact (Suc m - n) = of_nat (Suc m - n) * fact (m - n)"
sorry
lemma of_nat_binomial_Suc: assumes "k \<le> n" shows "(of_nat (Suc n choose k) :: 'a :: field_char_0) = of_nat (Suc n) / of_nat (Suc n - k) * of_nat (n choose k)"
sorry
lemma integrals_eq: assumes "f 0 = g 0" assumes "\<And> x. ((\<lambda>x. f x - g x) has_real_derivative 0) (at x)" shows "f x = g x"
sorry
lemma sum_diff: "((\<Sum>i\<le>n::nat. f (i + 1) - f i)::'a::field) = f (n + 1) - f 0"
sorry
lemma Rats_sum: "(\<And>x. x \<in> A \<Longrightarrow> f x \<in> \<rat>) \<Longrightarrow> sum f A \<in> \<rat>"
sorry
subsection \<open>Bernoulli Numbers and Bernoulli Polynomials\<close>
declare sum.cong [fundef_cong]
fun bernoulli :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a :: field_char_0" where "bernoulli 0 = 1" | "bernoulli (Suc n) = (-1 / (of_nat n + 2)) * (\<Sum>k \<le> n. (of_nat (n + 2 choose k) * bernoulli k))"
declare bernoulli.simps[simp del]
lemmas bernoulli_0 [simp] = bernoulli.simps(1) lemmas bernoulli_Suc = bernoulli.simps(2) lemma bernoulli_1 [simp]: "bernoulli 1 = -1/2" sorry
lemma bernoulli_Suc_0 [simp]: "bernoulli (Suc 0) = -1/2" sorry
lemma of_rat_bernoulli: "of_rat (bernoulli n) = bernoulli n"
sorry
lemma of_real_of_rat: "of_real (of_rat x) = (of_rat x :: 'a :: real_field)"
sorry
lemma of_real_bernoulli: "of_real (bernoulli n) = (bernoulli n :: 'a :: real_field)"
sorry
text \<open> The ``normal'' Bernoulli numbers are the negative Bernoulli numbers $B_n^{-}$ we just defined (so called because $B_1^{-} = -\frac{1}{2}$). There is also another convention, the positive Bernoulli numbers $B_n^{+}$, which differ from the negative ones only in that $B_1^{+} = \frac{1}{2}$. Both conventions have their justification, since a number of theorems are easier to state with one than the other. \<close> definition bernoulli' :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a :: field_char_0" where "bernoulli' n = (if n = 1 then 1/2 else bernoulli n)"
lemma bernoulli'_0 [simp]: "bernoulli' 0 = 1" sorry
lemma bernoulli'_1 [simp]: "bernoulli' (Suc 0) = 1/2"
sorry
lemma bernoulli_conv_bernoulli': "n \<noteq> 1 \<Longrightarrow> bernoulli n = bernoulli' n"
sorry
lemma bernoulli'_conv_bernoulli: "n \<noteq> 1 \<Longrightarrow> bernoulli' n = bernoulli n"
sorry
lemma bernoulli_conv_bernoulli'_if: "n \<noteq> 1 \<Longrightarrow> bernoulli n = (if n = 1 then -1/2 else bernoulli' n)"
sorry
lemma of_rat_bernoulli': "of_rat (bernoulli' n) = bernoulli' n"
sorry
lemma of_real_bernoulli': "of_real (bernoulli' n) = (bernoulli' n :: 'a :: real_field)"
sorry
lemma bernoulli_in_Rats: "bernoulli n \<in> \<rat>"
sorry
lemma bernoulli'_in_Rats: "bernoulli' n \<in> \<rat>"
sorry
definition bernpoly :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a :: real_algebra_1" where "bernpoly n = (\<lambda>x. \<Sum>k \<le> n. of_nat (n choose k) * of_real (bernoulli k) * x ^ (n - k))"
lemma bernpoly_altdef: "bernpoly n = (\<lambda>x. \<Sum>k\<le>n. of_nat (n choose k) * of_real (bernoulli (n - k)) * x ^ k)"
sorry
lemma bernoulli_Suc': "bernoulli (Suc n) = -1/(of_nat n + 2) * (\<Sum>k\<le>n. of_nat (n + 2 choose (k + 2)) * bernoulli (n - k))"
sorry
subsection \<open>Basic Observations on Bernoulli Polynomials\<close>
lemma bernpoly_0 [simp]: "bernpoly n 0 = of_real (bernoulli n)"
sorry
lemma continuous_on_bernpoly [continuous_intros]: "continuous_on A (bernpoly n :: 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a :: real_normed_algebra_1)"
sorry
lemma isCont_bernpoly [continuous_intros]: "isCont (bernpoly n :: 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a :: real_normed_algebra_1) x"
sorry
lemma has_field_derivative_bernpoly: "(bernpoly (Suc n) has_field_derivative (of_nat (n + 1) * bernpoly n x :: 'a :: real_normed_field)) (at x)"
sorry
lemmas has_field_derivative_bernpoly' [derivative_intros] = DERIV_chain'[OF _ has_field_derivative_bernpoly]
lemma sum_binomial_times_bernoulli: "(\<Sum>k\<le>n. of_nat ((Suc n) choose k) * bernoulli k) = (if n = 0 then 1 else 0)"
sorry
lemma sum_binomial_times_bernoulli': "(\<Sum>k<n. of_nat (n choose k) * bernoulli k :: 'a :: field_char_0) = (if n = 1 then 1 else 0)"
sorry
lemma binomial_unroll: "n > 0 \<Longrightarrow> (n choose k) = (if k = 0 then 1 else ((n - 1) choose (k - 1)) + ((n - 1) choose k))"
sorry
lemma sum_unroll: "(\<Sum>k\<le>n::nat. f k) = (if n = 0 then f 0 else f n + (\<Sum>k\<le>n - 1. f k))"
sorry
lemma bernoulli_unroll: "n > 0 \<Longrightarrow> bernoulli n = - 1 / (of_nat n + 1) * (\<Sum>k\<le>n - 1. of_nat (n + 1 choose k) * bernoulli k)"
sorry
lemmas bernoulli_unroll_all = binomial_unroll bernoulli_unroll sum_unroll bernpoly_def
lemma bernpoly_1_1: "bernpoly 1 1 = of_real (1/2)"
sorry
subsection \<open>Sum of Powers with Bernoulli Polynomials\<close>
(* TODO: Generalisation not possible here because mean-value theorem is only available for reals *) lemma diff_bernpoly: fixes x :: real shows "bernpoly n (x + 1) - bernpoly n x = of_nat n * x ^ (n - 1)"
sorry
lemma bernpoly_of_real: "bernpoly n (of_real x) = of_real (bernpoly n x)"
sorry
lemma bernpoly_1: assumes "n \<noteq> 1" shows "bernpoly n 1 = of_real (bernoulli n)"
sorry
lemma bernpoly_1': "bernpoly n 1 = of_real (bernoulli' n)"
sorry
dsp_request.statement: theorem sum_of_powers: "(\<Sum>k\<le>n::nat. (real k) ^ m) = (bernpoly (Suc m) (n + 1) - bernpoly (Suc m) 0) / (m + 1)"
